assessment: In this report, alterations of the brain cannabinoid type-1 receptor (CB1R) were identified in a mouse model of Williams-Beuren syndrome (CD mice). Modulation of CB1R by JZL184 treatment improved social and cognitive phenotypes and also cardiac function of CD mice. These are important and novel findings highlight a role of the endocannabinoid system and its dysfunction in Williams-Beuren syndrome (WBS) that provide a basis for future developments of potential therapeutics for WBS patients. This study will be of great interest to researchers and clinicians in the field of human genetic diseases.
